'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Nepal–Tibet floods]]
**[[Flash flood]]s and [[Mudflow|mudslide]]s along the [[Trishuli River]] impact between [[Nepal]] and [[Greater Tibet|Tibet]], [[China]]. At least 160 people are killed, hundreds are injured and 463 others, including over 200 [[Tourism in Nepal|tourists]], are reported missing in Nepal, while [[Chinese Communist Party]] officials report three deaths and 265 missing in Tibet, severely affecting [[Gyirong County]] and [[Gyirong Port|its port]]. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/08/26/massive-flood-near-tibet-border-kills-least-95-nepal/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')] [https://apnews.com/article/climate-change-nepal-flash-floods-7262dac22e31258955efa5c28c8fe917 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd948kn02e5o (BBC News)]
**[[Government of Nepal|Nepali officials]] say bridges, roads, [[power station]]s, and entire villages have been swept away by the [[flash flood]]ing with some areas still completely cut-off from [[search and rescue]] efforts. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/26/at-least-eight-killed-in-nepal-flash-floods-that-swept-away-villages-roads (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/asia/2026/08/26/nepal-tibet-flash-floods/ (''The National'')]
*At least 15 infants are killed and another is injured after a fire at a [[Healthcare in Pakistan|state-run hospital]] in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-at-least-15-infants-killed-in-pakistan-hospital-fire-local-media/ (''The Globe and Mail'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/26/newborn-babies-die-fire-pakistan-hospital-maternity-ward (''The Guardian'')]
*Twelve people are killed and at least 54 others are injured as [[wildfire]]s spread across northeastern [[Algeria]] during a severe [[heat wave]], with deaths reported in [[Béjaïa Province|Béjaïa]], [[Jijel Province|Jijel]], and [[Tizi Ouzou Province|Tizi Ouzou]] provinces. [https://gulfnews.com/world/africa/algeria-wildfires-kill-12-as-154-fires-rage-across-country-1.500653548 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Artificial intelligence in healthcare]]
**The [[University College London]] reports that neurosurgeons in [[London]], [[England]], have performed the first [[Artificial intelligence|AI]]-assisted [[Neurosurgery|brain surgery]] at the [[National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery]] in a 48-year old patient who was diagnosed with a [[brain tumor]] in 2024. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/aug/27/london-neurosurgeons-ai-assisted-operation-brain-tumour (''The Guardian'')] [https://news.sky.com/story/ai-helps-perform-brain-surgery-on-british-man-in-world-first-13577615 (Sky News)] [https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2026/aug/first-patient-live-ai-assisted-sight-saving-brain-surgery (UCL)]
*Nineteen cases of [[Japanese encephalitis]] are confirmed in [[Madhesh Province]], Nepal, causing six deaths. [https://english.nepalnews.com/s/health/japanese-encephalitis-in-madhesh-19-infected-6-dead/ (Nepal News)]
*The [[Food and Drug Administration|U.S. Food and Drug Administration]] approves the [[daraxonrasib]] drug as a treatment for [[Metastasis|metastatic]] [[pancreatic cancer]], making it the first [[Ras GTPase#RAS inhibitors|RAS inhibitor]] drug to be approved for the disease. This came after a previous study showed that it nearly doubled the survival rate for patients compared to [[chemotherapy]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/26/fda-approves-new-pancreatic-cancer-drug (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/revolution-medicines-gets-fda-nod-targeted-pancreatic-cancer-drug-2026-08-26/ (Reuters)]

*[[Lawsuits involving Meta Platforms]]
**[[Meta Platforms]] agrees to pay up to [[United States dollar|$]]16.7 billion to settle [[Cause of action|claims]] by 29 [[U.S. state]]s over alleged harms to young users and to impose new usage limits and safeguards for teenagers on its [[social media]] platforms [[Facebook]] and [[Instagram]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/technology/2026/8/26/meta-us-states-agree-16-7-b-settlement-in-landmark-teen-safety-case-2211 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

**The [[United States]] designates the [[Italy]]-based [[Hacktivism in Italy|Autistici/Inventati]], the [[UK]]-based [[Palestine Action]], and [[Palestinian nationalism|pro-Palestinian]] group Masar Badil as [[United States Department of State list of Foreign Terrorist Organizations|terrorist organizations]], citing alleged involvement in [[Political violence in the United States|politically motivated violence]] and [[extremist]] activity. [https://news.az/news/russia-places-faz-journalist-martens-on-international-wanted-list (News.az)]

The perpetrator is arrested. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260827-man-drives-car-into-group-of-pedestrians-in-french-city-of-caen-killing-one (France 24)]
